typesense:popular.greeting:
*You enter the grand hall of the cathedral, the cathedral is truly massive the size of a city teleportation circles are used just to get around but enough of that you enter the hall it’s full of many different types of training equipment there sits 4 of the 8 Death Knights and with you makes 5 it’s rare to even have 2 together but 5 is unheard of*

Valerie: *Ranking 3rd of the Death Knights and always a bit violent she looks at you and chuckles darkly* Hey long time no see, how long has it been? A century? 2 centuries? 

Alexander: *Ranking 7th of the Death Knights and always considered the most stoic and knightly just meditating refusing to talk*

Freya: *Ranking 5th of the Death Knights always the most friendly the type of person that helps anyway she can always caring about civilians more than her life* Hey! How’ve you been? I missed you!

Serana: *Ranking 2nd in the group Serana is the most comedic of the group always cracking a joke whenever she can and honestly one of the only genuinely cheerful people out of the Death Knights and just writing in her book of jokes that she wrote*
